author: kevaundray
content: Just making a summary of some questions that we could talk about on the breakout. Most of these can be answered async, this is also a good way to update people who are not following every thread since a lot was done since the last breakout call.

author: kevaundray
content:
**Items from last call**

- <@592004585506340885> : Do we have any open questions left in the specs or change anything since the last breakout?
      -  <@363800010518822915> asked a question about supporting sync which I think is something we have not included yet.
- <@1481393192950567003> : Did we manage to reproduce <@755590043632140352>  benchmarks on the NUC and have a solution for this?
- <@857052906495017000> : How far are we with the networking methodology doc? <@199561711278227457> Had a good idea where we test both devnets and simulations with a small-to-medium set of nodes to see if they broadly agree with each other on metrics, and then use simulations to extrapolate to larger devnets
- <@439032863904628745> : Has any progress been made on the simulations to figure out how we would potentially handle 32K signatures in a slot?
- <@412614104222531604> : Do we have any single client devnets working and are you blocked on the compact key state PR in leanVM?
- <@774033563732541451> : Do we have concrete numbers on what is cost to do a PoP for the migration contract in terms of gas on the EL and is it implemented?  <@755590043632140352> seems you are now fine with the PoP?

**Needs an owner**

<@531934490826768418> Are you happy to take on the ERCs for 2333, 2334 and 2335, plus I guess an ERC for specifying how one may generate the VRF?

**Open questions**

- <@520034910149410861>  / <@412614104222531604> : There seems to be some contention on whether we only require 0x02 validators to be able to migrate. Is it the right time to have a discussion on this in the breakout?
- <@774368154176454687> : We had a thread on what to do with 0x00 validators who have lost their key. Its not in the critical path, but it would be good to discuss

author: jsign
content:
> @ignacio (jsign) : Do we have concrete numbers on what is cost to do a PoP for the migration contract in terms of gas on the EL and is it implemented?  <@755590043632140352> seems you are now fine with the PoP?

Yes. It is implemented in [this repo](https://github.com/ethereum/pq-staking-contracts): 
- Concrete numbers on adding PoP optimized check to the original system contract without PoP, [here](https://github.com/ethereum/pq-staking-contracts/tree/main/contracts#gas-of-the-proof-of-possession). 
- Justin updated EIP with PoP in [this PR](https://github.com/potuz/EIPs/pull/4).
- (Optional) [More details](https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1570771708137312327/1573029190402445426) related to the work. It has extra links of PRs/test-vectors/etc, plus some extra brief discussion after VRF relationship with PoP (no need to read the history of that thread).
